README:
DELIBERATELY DANGEROUS SOURCE SHAPES, kept in a file that cannot execute.

Every string below is a fragment of JavaScript that a scanner must report.
They live in JSON, not in a .mjs file, for one reason: a control planted in
a suite file is indistinguishable, to any scan of that file, from the defect
it imitates. The previous round kept them inline and paid for it twice — the
scanner had to compose its own module specifier from fragments so its own
controls would not be counted, and that exemption device was then used to
obtain a real spawn API while every count still read zero.

JSON has no import syntax and no evaluation. Nothing here can run.

PLACEHOLDERS: {{CLEAN}} is the clean baseline source, {{REPO_PATH}} is a
fixture repo path, {{REVERSE_ALIAS_CHAIN}} is a generated alias chain.

WHAT CHECKS THIS FILE: every entry is exercised. `mustReport` entries must
each produce a finding containing their needle and `mustPass` entries must
produce none, with both table lengths pinned in the test titles, so an entry
that stops discriminating fails the run rather than sitting here decoratively.
